name: Same cache with addresses above the cache size
description: COPY instructions addressed through the same cache for addresses at or above s_same * 256
test_objectives: Verify the same cache stores an address at index address % (s_same * 256)
Verify addresses above the same cache size stay addressable (1000, 2000 and 3000)
Verify a mis-sized same cache is caught: it resolves these addresses to 0 without raising
